title: Marble Mayhem
intro.text: Every colour sends {n} marbles down the track. Before each race you secretly build in parts.
intro.r3: Yellow: flip it live on your phone during the race.
intro.r4: Blue: events for everyone – the track changes every round.
intro.points: {total} rounds · points by finishing place · bonus for the first marble
build.title: Build secretly now!
build.text: Everyone picks 2 of 3 parts on their phone and places them on free spots. If you already have {cap} parts, replace old ones first. If two want the same spot, whoever is further behind gets it.
build.textLast: Last round: you may play 3 cards – and all points count double.
reveal.title: This got built
d.farbweiche: flap open only for you or only for others
d.umleitung: flap open or closed for all
phone.intro: Your colour – you have {n} marbles. Look at the TV.
phone.pickSocket: Now tap a glowing spot on the track.
phone.allPlaced: All placed. Tap a part to take it back.
phone.legend: Dashed = free spot · white rim = your parts · you can't see what others are building right now. Drag the plan with your finger.
phone.mapHint: Big = your marbles, A/B = your parts to flip
phone.noToggles: Nothing to flip – just watch and cheer!
tg.farbweiche.on: Open just for you – yours drop a row
tg.farbweiche.off: Open for everyone else – only you roll on
tg.kanone.on: On: throws every marble far ahead
umbau.title: The track changes
umbau.added: Row {row}: there's now a {to} at the end.
umbau.removed: Row {row}: the end is open now.
umbau.wear: Row {worn} got a dent (slows down), row {polished} is polished (rolls better).
umbau.items: All built parts stay where they are.
intro.keep: At most {cap} parts per player – then you swap old for new.
werk.title: Marble workshop
werk.text: Design your marbles on your phone: colour and pattern.
werk.hint: All your marbles will look like this – and so will your name on the scoreboard.
flight.banner: Round {n} – one pass over the track
flight.text: The camera flies over the whole track. Every part shows what it does – new ones glow in their builder's colour.
result.title: Points for the marbles
result.rule: Per marble: the better the place, the more points (last place 10, each place ahead 10 more) · first marble +100 · traps +20 per marble caught{mult}
rm.text: Your parts stay on the track. Want to replace some? Pick up to {max} – they disappear and you have room again (max {cap} parts).
rm.full: You already have {cap} parts – that's the limit. Pick up to {max} to remove, then you may build that many new ones.
phone.capFull: You already have {cap} parts – only events are possible.
bet.hint: Guess whose marble crosses the line first. Right: +{n}
bet.done: Bet placed – you can still change it.
